notes: Read the full unit, wounded-veteran context, all eight candidates and the review. Restored the explicit commitment to end veteran homelessness and prompt job-market reentry as a key means. Identified the U.S. federal government as agent for both simplified hiring-tax-break paperwork and priority in training and employment.

claims.claim_text: The Republican Party commits to ending veteran homelessness, with prompt job-market reentry after military service as one key means.
The U.S. federal government should lead by simplifying paperwork for the veteran-hiring tax break.
The U.S. federal government should give veterans priority in training and employment.
